div.p: Designation of the basis for the other right, permission, or obligation described in the rightsStatement.
Values should be taken from a controlled vocabulary.

list.label: Obligation
list.item: Optional (Mandatory if the is another Righst basis)
list.label: Repeatability

div.p: Use this semantic unit for specific Rights bases other than copyright, license or, statute. When this semantic unit is used, 4.2.1 rightsBasis should be set to “other”.
The Rights basis may be specific to the repository, but it is recommended to use a value from a local or globally controlled vocabulary for machine actionability.
If more than one basis applies, the entire Rights entity should be repeated.
